newsitem.title: USA: TIME LIFE INC NAMES RALPH CUOMO CFO.
newsitem.headline: TIME LIFE INC NAMES RALPH CUOMO CFO.

text.p: Time Life Inc said Monday that it has named Ralph Cuomo chief financial officer and executive vice president, effective September 2.
Cuomo was formerly senior vice president of finance and operations for Book-of-the-Month Club Inc, a Time Inc unit headquartered in New York City.

In his new position he will have worldwide responsibility for finance, strategy and information services for Time Life Inc, which is one of the world's largest direct marketers of books, music and videos.
Time Life Inc is a unit of Time Warner Inc's Time Inc.
